'''Shakfa Flufm''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] living on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] who worked at [[Club Vertica Casino]] during a [[Soovada]] event.<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shakfa Flufm appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a Nightlife event vendor. She was added in version 5.2.2.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
